summary.message: 1 overflow issue detected: .zcnc-hero element overflows on ALL viewport sizes (78px mobile, 154px tablet, 288px desktop). Also 2 console JS errors persist (Google FedCM/Firebase).

findings.description: The .zcnc-hero section has a scrollWidth exceeding its clientWidth on all viewport sizes. This causes horizontal scrollbars or clipped content across devices.
findings.impact: The hero section adds horizontal scroll to the page, creating a poor UX on all devices. Content inside the hero may be clipped or force unwanted horizontal scrolling.
findings.suggestion: Set overflow:hidden on .zcnc-hero container OR ensure child elements have width constraints that respect the parent container. Check for fixed-width backgrounds, images, or CSS grid/flex items that don't wrap.

findings.description: Two persistent JavaScript console errors detected across all pages: (1) 'Provider's accounts list is empty' - likely Firebase/Google Auth init; (2) 'FedCM get() rejects with NetworkError' - Google Identity Services FedCM token retrieval fails.
findings.impact: User-facing impact unknown but indicates misconfigured Google sign-in or Firebase provider initialization. Could affect login/social auth functionality.
findings.suggestion: Verify Google OAuth client ID configuration and Firebase auth provider setup in the test environment.

findings.description: The search results page, category listing page, and pricing page show NO overflow issues across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports. All containers properly constrain their content.
findings.impact: No issue - these pages are responsive.

findings.description: Test mode banner visible: '⚠️ MODO TEST — entorno de pruebas. Los emails NO llegan a vendedores reales.' This is expected for the staging/test environment.
findings.impact: No issue - expected for test environment.
